**ACCEPT (engine-core seat #6019, session `session_01MwoubC3jL271FYt9rGXwxb`; direct-acceptance path — the dev agent was killed by the account token limit while polling CI; the PR body is the report of record).** PR #6680 reviewed against the diff and fresh CI (25/25 green).

The ruling landed as ruled: recognition widened to placeholder-by-INTENT, unknown ⇒ loud `UnknownFilterTokenError` with full identity (`code FILTER_TOKEN_UNKNOWN`, `status 400`, raw token echoed); **no escape hatch shipped** — the premise measurement found zero legitimate brace-literal comparands across 1927 structured metadata files, the TS corpus (4 hits, all flow templates that resolve upstream), and full showcase/CRM/todo builds. Consumers of `classifyFilterToken` declared per-face (core resolver changed-as-intended; lint changed-as-intended with 0 new findings on real metadata; `interpolateFilter` already conforming via its own wide regex + vocabulary predicate; the two narrow-grammar schemas and analytics macros untouched). Edge shapes are decisions with pins, including the deliberate no-trim refusal of `{ current_user_id }`. Reverse verification: 17 red, all wide-shape pins, all controls green. Rejection tests assert the full error envelope, never bare `toThrow()`. #5282's reserved core files verified untouched.

**One scope deviation, accepted with a note:** the dispatch scoped this card to `packages/core` and said stop-on-breach; the dev instead corrected the scope with evidence — the grammar's producer is `packages/spec/src/data/context-tokens.zod.ts`, and a core-side fix would have been a lenient consumer re-implementation. Right engineering call, wrong protocol order; the spec-surface touch is now declared post-hoc to the `domain:spec` seat on #6017 with a veto window (the #6532 precedent), and the acceptance-face measurement (zero new findings) is recorded there. Now: ready + auto-merge via the queue; issue closes on merge.
